member.name: T:ODDGames.Scripting.Editor.ScriptUiAllocationCheck
member.summary: Play-mode check that each case's script UI makes no garbage per frame: the player loop drives the panel (never driven by hand, which crashes the editor's render thread), bindings change every frame, and the profiler's per-marker GC and time are read back over three rounds, the best round counting, with the call stack of every allocation in a round whose panel allocated (clearing the Profiler window's frames). Results go to and the console. The game gives the cases (a script and its UI files each), its script loader, its panel settings and its script UI look.
Check each case with a UXML file in play mode: are (key, script source, UI files by path).
